grid.layout_notes: Official Game Description: 5 columns by 5 rows

win_system.notes: A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols, wilds or Orbs which are either vertically or horizontally connected.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected and then all symbols that were part of a winning combination, all triggered feature symbols and all Orbs explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position, after which new symbols drop in and potential features are added to fill the empty spaces on the feature row. The Avalanche cycle continues as long as new winning combinations or Orbs appear.
